scope: Surface and shading only for the shared FPS sleeve material MakeHuman_authored_FPS_uniform_CC0 in pistol/smg/rifle/sniper. No geometry, skin, rig, animation, UV or BIN change (earlier geometry attempts v18/v21/v23 stay rejected). Lighting in view-lighting.ts/renderer.ts is unchanged.
source_mode: Licensed source + deterministic postprocess. Tiling detail from Poly Haven CC0 'rough_linen' (photography colormass, processing Rico Cilliers), 2K nor_gl/ao/diff JPG, md5 verified against the Poly Haven files API. Existing licensed baked fold albedo/normal (V33) re-used; no generated or hand-painted pixels.

raw.compared_alternative: art-factory/cs/runs/run-20261010-v36-sleeve-surface/raw/polyhaven-denim_fabric_05 (CC0, rejected: twill below texel resolution at 512)

steps: Full seamless 2K tile resized to 512 (Lanczos3); no crop, so tiling is preserved
R = clamp(0.8 * ((ao/mean ao) * (diff luma / wrap-around Gaussian(24px) luma))^1.4, 0, 0.88): weave cavity and yarn slub
GB = OpenGL tangent normal XY, gain 1.4 about 0.5
JPEG q90, 4:4:4 chroma (packed data channels must not be chroma-subsampled), stored as shared/fps/<sha256>.jpg
GLB JSON only: occlusionTexture (strength 0.5, KHR_texture_transform scale 2), normalTexture.scale 1.8, material extras csFabricDetail; BIN byte-exact, all other JSON deep-equal
postprocess.runtime_shader: src/scripts/games/cs/fabric-detail.ts (onBeforeCompile; cache key cs-fabric-detail-v36): albedo *= (bakedAlbedo/atlasMean)^(foldContrast-1) * mix(1, R/cavityMean, albedoStrength); tangent normal xy += (GB*2-1)*normalStrength

alpha_policy: opaque cloth; chroma-key and alpha QA inapplicable
gates: Four FPS GLBs share one sealed detail image, identical transform/params (unit: fabric-detail-asset.test.ts)
BIN chunk byte-exact; only sleeve material, appended image/texture/sampler and extensionsUsed differ (cook asserts)
Shader patch validated before mutation, survives cloneModel (unit: fabric-detail.test.ts)
Same-camera real GameRenderer captures before/after: hip sun, hip shade, ADS, reload, move, smg, sniper, pistol; high and low quality
No WebGL program errors, unchanged viewmodel draw count per view

candidates.a-linen512: rejected: repeat 3, weak strengths; weave barely visible at hip distance
candidates.a-linen1k: rejected: 1024 detail 862,556 bytes pushes bundle to 32,568,860 (> budget)
candidates.b-linen512: rejected: readable weave but bright slub streaks read as scratches; folds not strengthened
candidates.c-denim512: rejected: twill pitch below 512 texel resolution, averages into blotchy blur
candidates.d-linen512: rejected after independent review: conditional pass but blotchy dark patches and cooler/dirtier hue (fold contrast 3, albedo 0.8)
candidates.e-linen512: selected: fold contrast 2.2, albedo 0.6, gain 1.4, slub ceiling 0.88 (addresses d review: fewer blotches, hue closer to baseline)

known_limits: No sewn cuff hem or seam line: adding one would require new geometry or painted pixels, both out of scope for this surface pass.
Weave is magnified linen at 512 px; individual threads are not resolved at hip distance, it reads as canvas grain and slub mottling.
Detail direction follows the existing V33 UV atlas, so the weave runs diagonal to the forearm in places.
Not CS2-equivalent: no sheen/fuzz term, no camo/print, no wear edges, baked fold albedo has minor blotches that the contrast boost makes more visible.
